questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Keep someone at arm’s length
options: 1) Restrict someone to a small space to stand
2) Allow someone to talk only from a distance
questions.solution: D) Keep someone at arm’s length(idiom) – Avoid being friendly with someone किसी से मित्रता ना रखना
